_tuning: repeatPenalty     : token repeat penalty multiplier (1.0=off). 1.1–1.2 typical; higher suppresses looping output.
frequencyPenalty  : extra penalty scaling with token occurrence count; reduces phrase-level repetition.
repeatLastN       : look-back window (tokens) for repeat_penalty. Higher catches longer-range repetition.
topK              : keep only top-K candidate tokens before sampling. Lower = more conservative. 0 = disabled.
topP              : nucleus sampling cutoff 0.0–1.0; 0.85–0.95 balances quality vs. determinism.
minP              : discard tokens with prob < minP × best_prob. 0.05–0.10 suppresses Han chars leaking into output.
